process.subtitle: Clear responsibilities at every step. The 491 has one additional stage compared to the 190 - the 3-year regional commitment period before the 191 PR application.

steps.title: Free Assessment - Points, Employment & ROI Prospects
steps.desc: Your RedBridge consultant confirms your points score, reviews your regional Victoria employment and earnings, and gives an honest assessment of whether you qualify for Victorian 491 nomination right now. If your current employment or location does not meet the requirements, we map what needs to change - or identify 190 or 189 as a faster alternative.

steps.title: Skills Assessment Preparation
steps.desc: A positive skills assessment is mandatory for the 491 - and must have at least 12 weeks validity remaining at nomination application stage. RedBridge prepares your ACS, AMI, or Engineers Australia submission in parallel with your EOI and ROI strategy to minimise the overall timeline.

steps.title: EOI in SkillSelect + ROI in Live in Melbourne
steps.desc: Insight Idea lodges your federal EOI selecting Victoria, then prepares and submits your ROI through the Live in Melbourne portal. Your ROI must include verified employment documentation, earnings evidence, and supporting documents for all claims.
steps.alert: 14-day nomination deadline: If Victoria invites you to apply for nomination, you must submit your full nomination application within 14 days. Insight Idea prepares all documentation in advance so you are never rushed when an invitation arrives.

steps.title: Regional Nomination Granted
steps.desc: Victoria approves your nomination. This adds +15 points to your SkillSelect score and triggers a federal invitation to apply for the 491 visa. You must lodge your visa application with the Department within 60 days.
steps.time: Weeks to months - no set timeline

steps.title: 491 Visa Granted
steps.desc: Your 491 is approved. You have a 5-year provisional visa to live and work in regional Victoria. Insight Idea briefs you on your obligations - living, working, and meeting the income threshold. RedBridge CRM tracks your 3-year milestone.

steps.title: 3 Years of Regional Living
steps.desc: You live and work in designated regional Victoria for 3 years, meeting the minimum taxable income threshold. Your employer does not need to match your nominated occupation during this period.
steps.alert: Income threshold: approximately $53,900 taxable income per year for 3 years is required for the 191 application. Tax returns are the primary evidence source.

steps.title: 191 Visa - Permanent Resident
steps.desc: After 3 years of regional residency, Insight Idea lodges your Subclass 191 Permanent Residence application. Upon grant, you become a Permanent Resident of Australia with full work rights anywhere in the country and a pathway to citizenship.
